en: A multiview tourist postcard with a blue border showing various color photographs of a mountain resort town surrounded by dramatic rocky peaks. The images include village streets with alpine-style hotels, ski lifts or cable cars, hikers among steep rock faces and snow patches, and panoramic views of a valley town and surrounding mountains. The title text at the top reads "S. MARTINO DI CASTROZZA."
